name: Photon
description: Open-source SDK and infrastructure for building AI agents on iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram and other messaging platforms. Products include Spectrum (multi-channel agent framework) and iMessage Kit (TypeScript SDK for macOS iMessage automation).
